claims.claim: Question, evidence, candidate DAG, selected DAG, and execution-unit artifacts need explicit provenance links.
Demo artifacts should remain machine-readable packet contracts, not only prose summaries.
Candidate graph plans should be represented as DAGs so acyclicity and topological execution order can be validated.
The implementation boundary should preserve concrete task artifacts and avoid prose-only handoff.

decision: Build the question-to-DAG demo in two slices: a deterministic CLI artifact flow first, then a local HTML presentation view over the same artifacts.
